description.text: Starter Sets TAG TEAM GX Espeon & Deoxys-GX and Umbreon & Darkrai-GX, two 60-card decks released together on 31 May 2019, each guaranteed a TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX among five Pokémon-GX, with a reprinted Tapu Lele-GX welcomed by players. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a rule book and a player's guide came with each. This set holds the cards of both.
